_comment: BCNF data-source provenance dimension + append-only ingest log. 'sources' is the data-source dimension keyed by id (uri is a 2nd candidate key, unique). 'ingested' is the append-only ingest log: a source MAY carry multiple rows (its history), keyed by the composite (source_id, ingested_at); source_id is a FK to sources. It carries NO uri — the uri is reached by joining to sources via source_id (BCNF: the transitive uri->id dependency is normalized out). The CURRENT ingest for a source is the row with the maximum ingested_at (DatasetIngestedFor); the whole ordered history is DatasetIngestHistoryFor. An exact-duplicate (source_id, ingested_at) is REJECTED at load. ingested_at is a COMMITTED SNAPSHOT timestamp, NEVER computed at load or codegen time — pinning it here is what keeps generated output byte-deterministic. The registry attestation rule (registry.go aggregate): every static row attests models.dev (empty Source means the models.dev origin is implicit); an enriched row whose Source names a further source (e.g. ollama) DUAL-attests both models.dev AND that source.
